product.description:
7G THCA Disposable – Rosin Edition

7 Grams. Flawless Rosin Blend. Advanced Hardware. Powerful Performance.

The Lost THC 7G Flawless Rosin Blend V2 Disposable combines a high-capacity formula with modern hardware built for smooth, flavorful, and consistent sessions.

Each device contains 7 grams of a carefully crafted cannabinoid and rosin blend designed to deliver rich flavor, strong effects, and lasting performance. With adjustable temperature settings, Turbo Mode, a ceramic heating element, and a detailed digital display, the V2 gives you more control over every session.

The Flawless Rosin Blend V2 Experience

The upgraded Flawless Rosin Blend is made to produce smooth pulls, bold terpene flavor, and a balanced experience from beginning to end.

Its advanced blend of THCA, THCP, and Delta 8 provides layered effects with impressive depth and strength. The clog-resistant design and ceramic coil help maintain consistent airflow and clean flavor, even during longer sessions.

Advanced V2 Hardware

The Lost THC 7G Flawless Rosin Blend V2 includes premium features designed for control, convenience, and reliable performance:

  • Three Temperature Settings to customize each pull

  • Turbo Mode for larger, more powerful clouds

  • Ceramic Coil for smooth and even heating

  • Preheat Function to improve airflow and help clear clogs

  • Digital Mega Display with real-time device information

  • Battery Life Indicator so you always know when to recharge

  • Oil Level Indicator to monitor the remaining blend

  • Voltage Indicator for greater control

  • USB Type-C Charging for fast and convenient recharging

  • Clog-Resistant Design for smoother, more consistent pulls

  • Ghost OG <0.3% Delta-9 THC

  • Rainbow Beltz 2.0 <0.3% Delta-9 THC

Trusted Manufacturing and Testing

Lost THC products are manufactured by an experienced team with more than seven years in the hemp industry. Each device is quality-controlled and third-party lab tested for potency, consistency, and compliance.
